title: S058 4.1.1.11 Mail-Parameter and Rcpt-Parameter Error Responses
parent_path: S058 4.1.1.11 Mail-Parameter and Rcpt-Parameter Error Responses

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If, for some reason, the server is temporarily unable to accommodate one or more of the parameters associated with a MAIL FROM or RCPT TO command, and if the definition of the specific parameter does not mandate the use of another code, it should return code 455.
